all_cache = {}
limit_cache = {}
n, m = 0, 0
def compute_all(start, end):
    if start == end:
        return 1
    if (start, end) in all_cache:
        return all_cache[(start, end)]
    all_cache[(start, end)] = 0
    all_cache[(start, end)] += compute_all(start + 1, end)
    all_cache[(start, end)] += compute_all(start, end - 1)
    for i in range(start + 1, end):
        all_cache[(start, end)] += compute_all(start, i - 1) * compute_all(i + 1, end)
    return all_cache[(start, end)]

def compute_limit(start, end, depth):
    global m
    if start == end:
        return 1 if depth < m else 0
    if (start, end, depth) in limit_cache:
        return limit_cache[(start, end, depth)]
    limit_cache[(start, end, depth)] = 0
    limit_cache[(start, end, depth)] += compute_limit(start + 1, end, depth + 1)
    limit_cache[(start, end, depth)] += compute_limit(start, end - 1, depth + 1)
    for i in range(start + 1, end):
        limit_cache[(start, end, depth)] += compute_limit(start, i - 1, depth + 1) * compute_limit(i + 1, end, depth + 1)
    return limit_cache[(start, end, depth)]

def main():
